2.20.betting_forecast: 7/2 Split Elevens, 6/1 Fistral Beach, Hint Of The Jungle, 13/2 English Lady, 9/1 Kamekist, 10/1 Brother Dave, King Sharja, 12/1
2.20.spotlight_verdict: He let favourite backers down here 17 days ago but KAMEKIST continues to lurk on a dangerous mark, and his close third over 6f here two starts ago suggested he might be ready to take advantage. With today's return to 7f likely to suit, he gets the nod. English Lady was a creditable third over C&D from a wide stall on her seasonal debut and is second choice. Hint Of The Jungle and Fistral Beach can also feature.[Chris Wilson]

horses.spotlight_comment: Gained all four wins on Polytrack, the latest last May; returned from break with poor run in December and has wide draw for this first start since; others have much stronger claims.
horses.breeding: b g Dandy Man - Haven's Wave

horses.spotlight_comment: Returned from break with hard-fought C&D win in January and has held his form pretty well since, albeit his latest run was a shade disappointing; current mark is workable; no surprise if he features.
horses.breeding: ch g Pastoral Pursuits - China Cherub

horses.spotlight_comment: Won over an extended 7f on turf last summer and was subsequently placed over 6f on Tapeta; made underwhelming reappearance this month and has wide draw today but might have needed that recent outing and may by aided by the new tongue-tie.

Dual 7f Polytrack winner; did well to finish third over C&D on recent seasonal debut, having endured a wide trip from stall 12, and is still quite lightly raced after only 12 starts; high on the list.
horses.breeding: b f Inns Of Court - English Queen

horses.spotlight_comment: Dual 7f winner at Wolverhampton this year, latterly when holding on well in first-time cheekpieces last month; probably bettered that form when second from wide stall there 18 days; respected in current mood.

Won twice over 7f (once here) in February and confirmed his wellbeing with respectable fifth at Kempton (6f) this month; probably doesn't have much margin for error off current mark but ought to be in the shake-up again.
horses.breeding: b g Bungle Inthejungle - Hint Of Red

horses.spotlight_comment: Unable to land a telling blow when favourite here (6f) this month but was close third off much-reduced mark here two starts ago and ought to be suited by today's return to 7f; tongue-tie removed after one use; it might pay to give him another chance.

Scored off 2lb higher over C&D last April and was also on target off today's mark on turf last summer; ran well when fresh last year and has a fighting chance if fully tuned up for this reappearance outing.

Quirky maiden who has often shown a tendency to race too freely and who lost all chance when virtually refusing to race on penultimate start; did well to take fourth over C&D last month, but remains a risky option.
11-time winner, most recently from off the pace over C&D last month; not in same form on either 8.6f start at Wolverhampton since, though, and might still be a shade too high in the weights.

Returned from break with three down-the-field runs this year but his fourth of ten over C&D three weeks ago was a big step back in the right direction and he's another 2lb lower today; considered each-way.
horses.breeding: gr g Havana Gold - Deux Saisons

horses.spotlight_comment: Ten-time AW winner; just a respectable fifth at Wolverhampton (7f) this month but remains on a workable mark and can't be ignored.

2.55.betting_forecast: 7/4 Invitorio, 3/1 Man On A Mission, 9/2 Arlington, 7/1 Nad Alshiba Snow, 8/1 Stash The Cash, 10/1 Marcus, 12/1 Beneficiary,
2.55.spotlight_verdict: It wasn't easy for INVITORIO over C&D last time out but he is still getting his eye in over this unfamiliar trip and the likely strong pace today will suit. Man On A Mission came as near as anything to ending a losing run here on Saturday and he can be the main danger although Arlington is likely to give it a good shot from the front.[Emily Weber]

horses.spotlight_comment: Three front-running C&D wins between last May and January; below best on last two starts but he might just have needed the recent sharpener following a break and can't be passed over too lightly.

Can lead; has won at both sprint trips on this course; two good runs in classified events during February but below best at Wolverhampton last month and was beaten nearly out of sight back over 5f on turf last time; first-time visor replaces blinkers; others higher up the list.
Winless in 12 starts and it was an uphill grind in handicaps last year; wore aids on last two starts but not today; one to watch on return from break.
horses.breeding: b g Bungle Inthejungle - Good Morning Lady

horses.spotlight_comment: First win over 6f and he's spent nearly all his handicapping life at that trip and 7f; however, the drop to 5f has worked well for him on last two starts, finishing strongly into second at Catterick then won over C&D 13 days ago; had little in hand there but just 3lb higher now; solid chance.

Clutterbuck Liam Wright (5) 3-1 52 62 67 LoveatfirstsightSeven AW wins have come elsewhere but he has often run well over C&D and did so again when only narrowly failing to end a losing run here on Saturday; had no problem with returning to 5f for the first time in over a year and a likely candidate.

Not yet off the mark but she hasn't always had the rub of the green for this yard and her latest run might have been needed; has run well on Wolverhampton Tapeta but this is her first course run so she does have a slight surface query.
horses.breeding: b f Oasis Dream - Lizzie Siddal

horses.spotlight_comment: Can lead; on a tempting mark relative to past turf form but he's 0-7 on the AW and has been well beaten since only just failing against Arlington over C&D in January; couldn't count on refitted blinkers, replacing a visor, returning him to form.

3.30.betting_forecast: 2/1 Shes Got A Brother, 5/2 Reigning Queen, 9/2 Society Kiss, 6/1 Dance Of Angels, 10/1 Queen Sana, 14/1 Magic Lady Mae,
3.30.spotlight_verdict: Shes Got A Brother has nothing to prove under the conditons having made a successful debut over C&D this month, the form of which has already been franked. However, she may not be able to concede 6lb to the nicely bred newcomer REIGNING QUEEN. The returning pair Society Kiss and Dance Of Angels are worth monitoring in the market.[David Bellingham]

horses.spotlight_comment: In the frame in two starts over 5f at Sandown (good) and Nottingham (good to soft) as a 2yo; stable has had a couple of winners recently and worth a market check on return from seven months off.
Well held in both starts, finishing over 6l behind Shes Got A Brother over C&D on the second occasion; 6lb pull not enough to tempt.
12-1 when beating one home on her Newcastle debut (6f, Tapeta) in December; major improvement required.

26,000euros foal; 11,000euros yearling, 35,000gns breeze-up 2yo; half-sister to winners So Chic (7f/1m AW; RPR 69) and Diego Spirit (Italian 6f 2yo/1m); dam placed 7f in France, sister to 7f-1m6f Flat/2m hurdle winner, half-sister to Italian 5f Listed winner Gamgoom; probably only of interest if backed on debut.
Third of ten on her Chelmsford return (7f, Polytrack) in March, but hasn't gone on in two subsequent starts; needs a resurgence down in tip.
horses.breeding: b f Mehmas - Black Magic Woman

horses.spotlight_comment: First foal; dam 5f/6f winner (including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 110), closely related to Swedish 6f winner Siphon River (including 2yo), half-sister to winners Mr Minerals (7f 2yo/1m), Insomnia (7f) and Ormskirk (6f-1m4f); appealing pedigree and makes her debut in a winnable race.
100,000gns 2yo; sent off 11-1 when making all on her debut over C&D 19 days ago; stable doesn't have many go in first time and the runner-up has won since, so she could be above-average; respected.

Both starts for Ralph Beckett last year were at Ascot (5f, good to firm), making a winning debut in May (form worked out well) before finishing in midfield in the Queen Mary the following month; half-sister to a couple of AW winners; market informative on stable debut (same owner) after 314 days off.

4.05.betting_forecast: 11/4 Jack Andrea, 3/1 Tupero, 11/2 Night Bear, 7/1 Arth's Gold, 9/1 Eagles Whistle, 10/1 Electric Bass, 12/1 Shaffron, 16/1
4.05.spotlight_verdict: On the face of it JACK ANDREA (nap) should struggle to confirm recent course form with both Arth's Gold and Night Bear at these revised weights, but something appears to have clicked and he may be able to pull out a bit more and gain another success. The unexposed Newcastle winner Tupero is also in the mix.[David Bellingham]

horses.spotlight_comment: Sole success came at Windsor (11.4f, heavy) in October 2024 and ended the last campaign with a fair second of seven at Nottingham (1m2f, soft); off six months and has run well fresh, but others still make greater appeal.

Rattled up a hat-trick in 0-50 classified events on Tapeta for Daragh Bourke (7f-9.5f) in January; has run with credit in her last three starts for this yard, but still has to conclusively prove she wants this far.
horses.breeding: ch m Free Eagle - Nannys Well

horses.spotlight_comment: Forced a dead-heat at Kempton (1m4f, Polytrack) in November, but was subsequently demoted so is technically 0-11; return to this trip should suit, but he has been off for 130 days; market useful.

In fine form in recent months and bids for a course hat-trick; had half a length to spare over Arth's Gold over this trip last time and is now 3lb worse off, but something appears to have clicked; major player.
horses.breeding: b g Time Test - Dutch Lady

horses.spotlight_comment: Often a front-runner and has won here six times, the latest (1m6f) in March; finished well behind a couple of these over C&D last time, though, so has a bit to find.
Just 1-30 on the AW, but the win came over C&D and he was only beaten a head by Jack Andrea here (1m3f) last month; 5lb pull makes him a player even though his losing run is mounting up.
Hinted at ability in five starts on turf/Polytrack last year without progressing; drops in grade on her return from 197 days off, but may be best watched unless attracting support.
horses.breeding: b f Sea The Moon - Shamakiya

horses.spotlight_comment: Patchy form since gaining his sole success here (1m) 13 months ago, but has run well on a couple of occasions over middle-distances on this track during that period; each-way claims if producing his best.

Showed improvement when off the mark at Newcastle (1m4f, Tapeta) in February and ran at least as well when chasing home a subsequent winner at Catterick (1m4f, good) this month; still unexposed after just six starts and high on the list.

4.35.betting_forecast: 9/2 Payment Plan, 11/2 Regal Glory, 13/2 Charlie Darling, 7/1 Apache Eagle, Sullivan Bay, 15/2 Different Drum, 8/1 Colinski, 11/1
4.35.spotlight_verdict: Market support for dual C&D winner Payment Plan should be heeded, while recent hurdle winner Different Drum and Saturday's course runner-up Apache Eagle are also worthy of consideration. However, there was plenty to like about CHARLIE DARLING's third over C&D earlier this month and he takes on lesser company this time.[David Bellingham]

horses.spotlight_comment: 0-15 but has been placed in his last two starts over 1m6f here, the latest when second of 11 on Saturday; 1lb out of the weights this time, but still each-way material.
Dual turf winner in Ireland who was having his third start for this yard when third of eight over C&D this month; drops in grade and every chance if building on that performance.

Sole win came at Lingfield (11.6f, good; first-time cheekpieces) for James Owen last June, but out of the frame in two starts on the AW since returning for this yard last month; didn't enjoy a clear run on either occasion, but he still needs to step up.
Dual 1m4f winner on Tapeta elsewhere; placed three times from six starts over this sort of trip on Tapeta and could make the frame from just 2lb above his last winning mark.
horses.breeding: b g Lope De Vega - Crystal Melody

horses.spotlight_comment: Twice ran poorly over C&D during the winter, but has winning form at Newcastle (2m, Tapeta) and was successful over hurdles this month; a player if transferring that form back to the Flat.
Some good performances last year as when beaten a short head off this mark over C&D in November; needs to better her two efforts since returning last month, though.
horses.breeding: b g Sea The Moon - Hi Calypso

horses.spotlight_comment: 0-7; best effort when third of 12 in a 0-50 classified event at Lingfield (1m4f, Polytrack; first-time cheekpieces) last month; has something to prove over this far, though.

Dual C&D winner in November 2024, but finished miles behind Charlie Darling on his return from 11 months off back here 26 days ago; the market should indicate whether a much better effort is anticipated.
Has run some good races on turf/Tapeta this year, but a record of 1-37 sounds a note of caution and she is unraced beyond 1m6f.
horses.breeding: b m Cotai Glory - Regal Salute

horses.spotlight_comment: Returns to the AW after another modest effort over hurdles, but was twice runner-up on Polytrack before that; both wins have come on that surface, but he ran well to finish a close third behind Payment Plan over this C&D in November 2024; each-way claims again.

5.10.betting_forecast: 5/2 Mount Ruapehu, 4/1 South Shore, 13/2 Dr Ali, 8/1 Pinjarra, Queensmaite, 10/1 East Tyrone, Mu Mu Land, Tommytwohoots,
5.10.spotlight_verdict: Still in form and returning to the scene of his last two wins, MOUNT RUAPEHU gets the nod ahead of Dr Ali, East Tyrone and Tommytwohoots.[Alistair Jones]

horses.spotlight_comment: Record of 1-26; shown nothing in two runs after wind surgery and too risky to contemplate.

Doubled his tally when reeling in the long-time leader at Wolverhampton a month ago (6f); that was a classified race but his mark was left untouched, so only 2lb higher than for his previous win; has form here.
horses.breeding: b g Invincible Army - Pure Symmetry

horses.spotlight_comment: Can miss the break and tends to pull hard; still deserves some respect after a recent third over C&D.
12-race maiden who was sixth of nine here 23 days ago after a break; she wouldn't be the obvious answer.
The hat-trick bid came up shy but at Wolverhampton and he seems better here, the scene of his two previous wins; certainly not handicapped out of it.
Has won three 6f events on AW since August, one here; last run at Pontefract forgiven as he was drawn wide but he was also below par here the time before when behind Mount Ruapehu.
Third in a 5f maiden here on debut but it's been a quiet start in handicaps (here) and now goes in cheekpieces.
Last run was too bad to be true and had made a positive start for this yard, and he's closely matched with Dr Ali; possibilities.
horses.breeding: b g Bated Breath - Lady Lube Rye

5.42.betting_forecast: 3/1 Shamacid, 7/2 Cill Mocheallog, Receipt, 9/2 Dapper Gee Gee, 5/1 Phoenix Of Dreams, 12/1 Wish This, 25/1 Stoneywell.
5.42.spotlight_verdict: This may go to SHAMACID who showed the benefit of wind surgery and the fitting of a tongue-tie when just missing out at Kempton. Handicap debutant Receipt and Phoenix Of Dreams are rated the chief threats.[Alistair Jones]

horses.spotlight_comment: Not the easiest to predict but came from off the pace for a second career win on his first visit to Wolverhampton in March (7f; 2lb lower); breakthrough win in January was over C&D.
horses.breeding: gr g Phoenix Of Spain - Excel Yourself

horses.spotlight_comment: Wins have been over 6f on turf and 7f on the AW (Newcastle); has been running well for a while and latest effort back at Newcastle was better than it looks.
horses.breeding: b g Phoenix Of Spain - Dreaming Of Rubies

horses.spotlight_comment: Sharp pedigree but started out in bumpers; no match for the winner in a C&D novice last time but that's something to build on now handicapping.
No wins in 11 but his first run after a gelding operation and in a tongue-tie when going down narrowly in a close finish at Kempton (7f); mark untouched so every chance with a repeat.
The third in a Leicester novice last October is his standout run; 80-1 for a C&D handicap here in March and never counted (first-time hood).
Signed off last season with a win over 6f at Newcastle and, although only sixth here after a break 17 days ago, he only faded late on; could be happier over this extra furlong.
